n3d5bc92f40.headline: Russell Investments buys Australia's Zurich Investment Management
n3d5bc92f40.summary: Russell Investments has agreed to buy Australia's Zurich Investment Management, as the insurer divests its asset manager to focus on core insurance.
n3d5bc92f40.why: Asset management consolidation changes competitive positions among fund managers and reflects insurers reshaping their portfolios around core insurance businesses.

ndfc42b70fb.headline: Abu Dhabi Airports Achieves Record Traffic in 2025
ndfc42b70fb.summary: Abu Dhabi Airports handled over 33 million passengers in 2025, a record for the emirate, with traffic across its five airports having doubled in three years.
ndfc42b70fb.why: Passenger volumes drive airport revenues and support tourism, aviation and retail activity in the UAE.

n46d61f415e.headline: Industrial parks power Azerbaijan’s non-oil growth with Chinese and Turkish technologies
n46d61f415e.summary: The Sumgayit Industrial Park has 40 active resident enterprises over 640 hectares. It has attracted 5.5 billion manats in investment and employs 6,135 people.
n46d61f415e.why: Industrial parks are government-backed zones that attract manufacturing investment. Their growth reflects efforts to diversify economies away from oil and gas.

n99b3f8efbc.headline: LT Foods cancels Global Green Group acquisition following Hungary's rejection - CNBC TV18
n99b3f8efbc.summary: LT Foods withdrew its proposed acquisition of Global Green Group after Hungary's Ministry of National Economy rejected the deal over national economic and sectoral risk concerns.
n99b3f8efbc.why: Cross-border acquisitions by foreign companies can be blocked by governments on national security or economic grounds, which affects deal certainty for investors.

n5fa0e1a5d8.headline: Explained: Visa’s dual-hub strategy in Dubai and Riyadh as Saudi Arabia tightens the rules
n5fa0e1a5d8.summary: Global payments company Visa is reorganising its Middle East operations into a dual-hub model in Dubai and Riyadh. The move reflects Saudi Arabia's regional headquarters policy being rewritten.
n5fa0e1a5d8.why: Visa is a global payments network, and regional headquarter rules affect where multinationals book operations and staff in the Gulf.

nc8f4c25a0e.headline: Asia stocks gain, gold jumps after US rates unchanged
nc8f4c25a0e.summary: Global shares traded mixed as a wait-and-see mood dominated Asian markets, while gold jumped after US rates were left unchanged.
nc8f4c25a0e.why: The Federal Reserve sets the US federal funds rate, which influences global borrowing costs, the dollar and risk appetite. Gold often reacts to changes in real rates and dollar expectations.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: The article states gold jumped after the rate decision.

nc8f4c25a0e.why_moved: Gold jumped after US rates were left unchanged, according to the headline, while Asian shares were mixed.

na9242ecb83.headline: Brent tops $71/barrel, approaches Aug high
na9242ecb83.summary: Brent futures jumped to a near six-month high on Thursday as concerns grew over a possible US military attack on Iran. Prices are approaching their August peak.
na9242ecb83.why: Brent is the main global benchmark for crude oil, so Middle East tensions that threaten supply quickly feed into energy costs, inflation expectations and energy equities.
na9242ecb83.why_moved: Concerns about a possible US military attack on Iran raised fears of supply disruption in a key oil-producing region.

n50b1f89617.headline: New director for insurer Southern Cross
n50b1f89617.summary: Spanish Foreign Minister Jose Manuel Albares called India a trusted partner and backed a free trade agreement with the EU while stressing deeper bilateral cooperation.
n50b1f89617.why: Free trade agreements reduce tariffs and shape cross-border investment flows, making EU-India trade talks relevant to exporters and investors in both regions.

n76c503f1ba.headline: It has been backed by Trump and Rinehart — but where is the Arafura mine?
n76c503f1ba.summary: The Arafura mine, backed by Donald Trump and Gina Rinehart, is promised to help reduce China's rare earths dominance and bring hundreds of jobs to Australia. Its location is questioned.
n76c503f1ba.why: Rare earths are critical minerals for magnets and electronics, and China dominates their processing, so new non-Chinese supply is closely watched by investors.

n31102245f5.headline: Brent Settles Above $70 as Iran Tensions Rise
n31102245f5.summary: Brent crude rose above $70 and WTI climbed above $65 amid fears of supply disruption in the Strait of Hormuz. The rise reflects heightened Iran-related tensions.
n31102245f5.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of global seaborne oil, so any threat to flows there typically lifts crude prices and energy-sector shares.
n31102245f5.why_moved: Fears of supply disruption in the Strait of Hormuz amid rising Iran tensions pushed both Brent and WTI higher.

nfb73432264.headline: REC Ltd Net Profit Slightly Rises To ₹4,043 Crore In Q3, Revenue At ₹14,911 Crore Amid Marginal QoQ Dip
nfb73432264.summary: REC Limited's standalone net profit rose 0.3 percent year on year to Rs 4,043 crore in Q3 FY26. Revenue from operations climbed to Rs 14,911 crore, though profit was below the prior quarter.
nfb73432264.why: REC Limited is an Indian state-owned lender that finances power sector projects, so its results reflect lending activity in India's power infrastructure.

na62be720e5.headline: Nine Acquires QMS, Sells Radio Assets
na62be720e5.summary: Nine has acquired QMS and sold its radio assets, according to B&T. The report did not give deal terms in the available description.
na62be720e5.why: Nine Entertainment is a major Australian media group, and portfolio changes between television, radio and outdoor businesses affect its earnings mix.

ndb600ae302.headline: Why has gold price fallen 5% and will it continue to dip now or make a comeback? Gold price dream run ends after record highs. Here
ndb600ae302.summary: Gold prices dropped about 5% after touching record highs as investors booked profits, with silver and other metals also falling. Markets are tracking Federal Reserve policy and geopolitical tension.
ndb600ae302.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that investors use to hedge against inflation, currency weakness and geopolitical risk. Its price moves are closely watched across commodity and macro markets.
ndb600ae302.why_moved: Investors took profits after gold reached record highs, according to the report. Markets are also weighing Federal Reserve policy and geopolitical tensions.

n1fd3a919f2.headline: Nissan Motor Dec. Global Production Up 10.7%
n1fd3a919f2.summary: Nissan Motor's global production rose 10.7% in December from a year earlier to 241,227 vehicles. Production in Japan declined 8.
n1fd3a919f2.why: Nissan is a major Japanese automaker, and its monthly production figures indicate volume trends across its global plants.

n0612d0e837.headline: A Trump card : India EU trade agreement
n0612d0e837.summary: The European Union and India have reached a historic Free Trade Agreement, according to the commentary. The opinion piece frames the deal as a significant shift in the global economic landscape.
n0612d0e837.why: Free trade agreements lower tariffs and reshape trade flows, affecting exporters, importers and investment in both economies.

n1cff4ca1c8.headline: Tech-based enforcement needed to combat RON95 misuse, says PDAM
n1cff4ca1c8.summary: The Malaysian Automotive Association suggested technology-enabled enforcement to detect foreign-registered vehicles filling up with subsidised RON95 fuel meant for Malaysians. The subsidy misuse is a concern in Klang.
n1cff4ca1c8.why: RON95 is a subsidised fuel grade in Malaysia, and subsidy leakage affects government spending and fuel supply costs.

n8083932421.headline: China relaxes visa rules for UK citizens on PM's trip to Beijing
n8083932421.summary: China will allow visa-free travel for British citizens staying under 30 days, during Prime Minister Keir Starmer's Beijing trip. A feasibility study on a services agreement is also included.
n8083932421.why: Easier travel supports business visits and trade in services. The UK's services sector is a major part of its economy, so market access matters to British firms.

nad2cd44c3b.headline: Apple posts record quarter on soaring iPhone sales
nad2cd44c3b.summary: Apple reported record first-quarter results with sales up 16%, as demand for the iPhone and services surged.
nad2cd44c3b.why: Apple is one of the largest companies by market value, and its iPhone and services results are closely watched as indicators of consumer tech demand.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: Record quarterly results with 16% sales growth were reported, driven by iPhone and services demand.

n6f61402254.headline: EU and Vietnam elevate relations to a comprehensive strategic partnership
n6f61402254.summary: The European Union and Vietnam announced an upgrade of their bilateral relationship to a comprehensive strategic partnership. The move marks 35 years of bilateral relations.
n6f61402254.why: Trade and investment frameworks between the EU and Southeast Asian economies shape supply chains and market access for European and Vietnamese exporters.

n3b3099b1db.headline: Tesla cuts car models in shift to robots and AI
n3b3099b1db.summary: Tesla's annual revenue fell for the first time as the electric vehicle maker cut car models and shifted focus to artificial intelligence and robotics.
n3b3099b1db.why: Tesla is the largest pure-play electric vehicle maker, and its revenue trend is a key gauge of EV demand and its growth story.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The first annual revenue decline and model cuts bear directly on Tesla's sales and growth outlook.

n3b3099b1db.why_moved: The first annual revenue decline in the company's reported results, alongside a cut in car models, challenges the growth expectations tied to its vehicle business.

n03683c533f.headline: China’s Crude Hoarding Is Propping Up Oil Prices
n03683c533f.summary: China's crude imports hit record highs, with December stockpiling estimated at 2.67 million bpd, the fastest pace since 2020. Beijing bought while prices were low and expanded storage.
n03683c533f.why: China is the world's largest crude importer, so its stockpiling decisions can materially shift global oil demand and prices.
n03683c533f.why_moved: Record crude imports and an estimated 2.67 million bpd of December stockpiling add demand, while expanded storage lets Beijing buy at low prices.

n50e1f44d2c.headline: Canada’s Carney hails new trade deals, ‘expects’ US to respect sovereignty
n50e1f44d2c.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney welcomed new trade deals and sought to rally 'middle powers' amid an increasingly unpredictable global climate.
n50e1f44d2c.why: Canada's trade arrangements with the US and other partners directly affect exporters, supply chains and the Canadian dollar.

ne169825de7.headline: investingLive AsiaPacific FX news wrap: Gold rocketed to near $5600, dipped back, up again
ne169825de7.summary: Gold rocketed to near $5,600 and then dipped back before rising again in Asian trading on January 29, 2026. The wrap covers Asian FX market news.
ne169825de7.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and is priced globally in US dollars. Its moves often influence currency and risk sentiment.
ne169825de7.why_moved: Gold traded sharply higher near $5,600 in Asian hours before pulling back and rising again. The input does not give the cause.

n114ef1867e.headline: Hyundai Motor reports bigger-than-expected profit fall in Q4 as US tariffs bite
n114ef1867e.summary: Hyundai Motor reported a worse-than-expected 40% fall in fourth-quarter operating profit due to U.S. tariffs. It forecast higher sales and profit margin for 2026.
n114ef1867e.why: Hyundai Motor is one of South Korea's largest carmakers and a major exporter to the United States. Tariffs directly affect its margins.

nde6b42c485.headline: Lackluster GDP results pull down stocks
nde6b42c485.summary: Stocks fell back to the 6,200 level after gross domestic product growth came in lower than expected. The weak data hit the market sharply.
nde6b42c485.why: GDP growth is the broadest gauge of economic activity, and weaker growth typically lowers corporate earnings expectations and weighs on equities.
nde6b42c485.why_moved: Lower-than-expected GDP growth pointed to slower economic activity, which pulled the stock market back down to the 6,200 level.

ne9446ff799.headline: PEZA OKs P12.86 billion investments in January
ne9446ff799.summary: The Philippine Economic Zone Authority approved P12.86 billion in investments in January. Approvals fell 57 percent from a year earlier, and the agency hopes to attract more through ease-of-doing-business efforts.
ne9446ff799.why: The Philippine Economic Zone Authority approves investment projects in export zones, and its approvals signal the pace of foreign and domestic investment.

n2476067b45.headline: GoTyme scaleup boosts IPO plan
n2476067b45.summary: Digital lender GoTyme Bank is looking at a potential initial public offering in three to four years. The bank is focusing on doubling its customer base and expanding its business scale.
n2476067b45.why: Digital banks are lenders that operate mainly through mobile apps, and their listings give public investors access to fast-growing financial firms.

n878ca6948e.headline: Government sets 2026 as rally point to hasten development, restore public trust
n878ca6948e.summary: The Economic and Development Council chaired by President Marcos set 2026 as a rally point to fast-track its development blueprint. The aim is also to restore public confidence.
n878ca6948e.why: The national development blueprint sets infrastructure and investment priorities that affect long-term planning for businesses and investors.
